_comment: What the AppImage carries besides BirdoVPN and the system libraries: the AppImage runtime (the ELF program at
the start of the .AppImage file, which mounts the rest) and the AppRun launcher, plus what linuxdeploy writes.
Owner decision 2026-10-14 (L2, review rounds 1-2). scripts/ci/fetch-appimage-tooling.sh fetches the pinned
runtime and AppRun (refusing any other bytes) and hands them to the bundler: the runtime via linuxdeploy-plugin-
appimage's LDAI_RUNTIME_FILE (appimagetool --runtime-file; otherwise it downloads whatever type2-runtime's moving
`continuous` build is that day), AppRun into Tauri's tool cache. The runtime is the build BirdoVPN 1.4.46 shipped
(type2-runtime 8f39b89): from `url` while type2-runtime's continuous release still serves it, else rebuilt from
1.4.46's own release asset (`fallback`: its first `bytes` bytes with the `zero` range - the .digest_md5 section
appimagetool fills in - set back to zero); both must hash to `sha256`. scripts/generate-appimage-notices.mjs
checks the built AppImage carries exactly this runtime and this AppRun, and lists them, the libraries the runtime
links statically and the linuxdeploy-generated files in the AppImage's notices. scripts/build-corresponding-
source.mjs mirrors the runtime's source, libfuse's and squashfuse's in each release's corresponding-source asset
(LGPL-2.1 section 6). On a bump: take every version below from the new runtime's build scripts at its commit
paths), update the sha256s and the fallback, and vendor the texts.

runtime.name: AppImage type2-runtime

fallback.what: the same runtime as BirdoVPN 1.4.46 shipped it: the start of its AppImage, with the .digest_md5 section appimagetool fills in set back to zero

runtime.build: built by type2-runtime's CI in an alpine:3.21 container (scripts/docker/Dockerfile) with clang 19.1.4; statically linked, static-pie

linked.name: libfuse
linked.note: its lib/ and include/, patched with type2-runtime's patches/libfuse/mount.c.diff and linked statically

apprun.name: AppImageKit AppRun
apprun.note: Tauri's mirror of AppImageKit's continuous AppRun-x86_64 (the same bytes); linuxdeploy renames it AppRun.wrapped

generated.what: the launcher script linuxdeploy writes (it runs the hook below, then AppRun.wrapped)
the environment hook the GTK plugin writes (Tauri CLI embeds its copy of linuxdeploy-plugin-gtk)
